name: Codersly Booking
author: Codersly

sections.description:
Codersly Booking Free provides a clean basic appointment request form for a single service.

Free features:

  • One service with a fixed 30-minute duration.
  • One shared opening and closing time for all open weekdays.
  • Basic date and time booking form.
  • Customer name, email and phone fields.
  • Pending booking workflow.
  • Approve, reject and delete actions.
  • Basic new-booking email to the administrator.
  • Double-booking protection, rate limiting and privacy tools.
  • Shortcode: [codersly_booking]
  • Automatically creates and maintains the Book an Appointment page with the shortcode.
  • Focused admin screens for Dashboard, Appointments, the single Service, Schedule and Settings.
  • Informational pages identify capabilities supplied by the separately distributed Pro add-on.
  • Context-specific tabs for appointment status and Free settings.
  • Frontend Pages, Privacy and Tools & Data are organized inside Settings to keep wp-admin clean.
  • The Frontend Pages section can repair missing pages without overwriting customized content.

Pro-only sections display informational placeholders and contain no premium implementation code in the Free plugin.
The separately distributed Pro add-on supplies its own multi-service data model and advanced booking implementation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the codersly-booking folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate Codersly Booking.
  3. Configure the service, availability and settings.
  4. Use the automatically created booking page or add [codersly_booking] to any page.
sections.faq:
Does the Free version support multiple services?

No. Codersly Booking Free supports one service.

Does it send customer confirmation emails?

No. The Free version sends only a basic new-booking email to the business administrator.

Does the plugin contact an external service?

No. Codersly Booking Free does not contact a Codersly license server or any other external service.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Made the Free data model genuinely single-service with a fixed 30-minute duration.
  • Kept multi-service and configurable-duration implementation exclusively in the separate Pro add-on.
  • Removed license-state coupling and corrected the public plugin URL.

1.0.0

  • Updated Pro compatibility for recurring appointments, group capacity, extras, coupons and advanced reporting.
  • Initial Free release with one service, one basic schedule and pending appointment management.
  • Added the shared Codersly admin UI shell and automatic booking page maintenance.
  • Added a central page registry and Repair Pages tool for Free and Pro shortcodes.
  • Reorganized the admin menu and added context-specific appointment, calendar, service and settings tabs.
  • Added Currency & Tax, Tools & Data, Privacy and Frontend Pages settings sections.
  • Added activation/load safeguards and delayed frontend-page repair until WordPress initialization is complete.
  • Corrected dashboard card icon spacing and added a booking-related sidebar icon.

Recurring appointment series and group-capacity support are available through Codersly Booking Pro.
